meta.title: JOURNEYWAYS | Components
meta.description: The components of JOURNEYWAYS: the card decks, the hand-drawn map tiles, and (soon) the player booklet and user manual. Choose a component to explore it.

hero.title: The pieces of the game.

hero.lead: Choose a component to explore it up close.

cards.title: Cards
cards.desc: Five decks of prompts and quotes, Encounter, Movement, Reflection, Countdown, and Group. Pick a deck to deal it out.

cards.title: Tiles
cards.desc: Hand-drawn square map locations, plus blank tiles you draw yourself. Pick a tile to see it up close.

cards.title: Player Booklet
cards.desc: A write-in booklet for each player: character-creation prompts, lined journal pages, and a character sheet. Preview it or download it to print.

cards.title: Game Manual
cards.desc: How to set up and play JOURNEYWAYS, solo or in a group: the loose rules, the turn, and what each card colour means. Preview it or download it to print.
